subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw treat custom `bailian` provider rows with Qwen `compat.thinkingFormat` as reasoning-capable by default, or keep Bailian reasoning enablement only in provider-owned Qwen/Coding Plan work?
rationale: The code gap is source-reproducible, but the PR changes upgrade behavior for existing custom provider configs and overlaps a broader provider-support issue that still needs maintainer boundary and vendor-proof judgment.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom Inference After Cleanup
options.body: Allow the generic configured-model inference change once the vLLM hook is removed, focused tests are added, and changed-path Bailian proof is posted.

options.title: Keep Reasoning Provider-Owned Only
options.body: Reject the custom-provider inference path and route Bailian/Coding Plan reasoning through Qwen-owned catalog and provider logic instead.

options.title: Defer To Canonical Issue
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/26037 has a complete model/region support decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Custom Inference After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow the generic configured-model inference change once the vLLM hook is removed, focused tests are added, and changed-path Bailian proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the Qwen provider surface and prior maintainer routing for the broader Bailian/Coding Plan issue.
